intro: Начать and продолжить usually take the imperfective to name the activity; закончить indicates that the end of that activity was reached.

piezas.titulo: Начать and продолжить usually take the imperfective to name the activity; закончить indicates that the end of that activity was reached.
texto: Начать and продолжить usually take the imperfective to name the activity; закончить indicates that the end of that activity was reached.
The aspect is chosen according to the meaning of the main verb, not by a single translation rule.

frases.estudio: Он начал читать статью после обеда.
frases.alumno: He started reading the article after lunch.

frases.estudio: К вечеру она закончила писать отчёт.
frases.alumno: By the evening she had finished writing the report.

opciones.explicacion: After закончить the activity is named with the imperfective: переводить.
This form does not express the relation the question asks about.
Check which word governs the case or the structure.

pregunta.texto: What does this phrase mean? «Он начал читать статью после обеда.»

frase.texto: Он начал читать статью после обеда.

opciones.texto: He started reading the article after lunch.
opciones.explicacion: It corresponds to the first example.

opciones.texto: By the evening she had finished writing the report.
opciones.explicacion: That is the translation of the second example.

frase.texto: К вечеру она закончила писать отчёт

piezas.traduccion: By the evening she had finished writing the report.
piezas.explicacion: Pay attention to the order of the words and to the grammatical form highlighted.
